name: Bedeviling Blade (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
body:
Magic is a great tool, but often it’s easier just to be a sneaky bastard. Subtlety has its own advantages.

Class Skills: The bedeviling blade adds Acrobatics (Dex), Appraise (Int), Climb (Str), Disable Device (Int), Disguise (Cha), Escape Artist (Dex), Perception (Wis), Sense Motive (Wis), Sleight of Hand (Dex), Stealth (Dex), and Swim (Str) to their class skill list.

This modifies class skills.

Sneak Attack (Ex)

The bedeviling blade gains sneak attack as a rogue of equal level.

This replaces arcane surge.

Finesse Training (Ex)

At 1st level, a bedeviling blade gains weapon Finesse as a bonus feat. In addition, starting at 3rd level, they can select any one type of weapon that can be used with weapon Finesse (such as rapiers or daggers). Once this choice is made, it cannot be changed. Whenever they make a successful melee attack with the selected weapon, they add their Dexterity modifier instead of their Strength modifier to the damage roll. If any effect would prevent them from adding their Strength modifier to the damage roll, they do not add their Dexterity modifier.

This replaces the arcane exploit gained at first level.

Arcanist Exploits

A bedeviling blade can select from the following additional exploits.

Ranged Legerdemain (Su)

The bedeviling blade can use mage hand as a supernatural ability and can Disable Device and Sleight of Hand at a range of 30 feet. Working at a distance increases the normal skill check DC by 5, and the bedeviling blade cannot take 10 on this check. Any object to be manipulated must weigh 5 pounds or less.

Sudden Spell (Ex)

The bedeviling blade can add their sneak attack damage to any spell that deals damage, provided the target is flat-footed and within 30 feet. The additional damage is of the same type as the spell. If the spell allows a saving throw to negate or halve the damage, it also negates or halves the sneak attack damage as well. The damage is only applied once, when the spell is initially cast. If the spell generates multiple rays or missiles, the extra damage is only added once to one ray or missile, chosen when the spell is cast.

Superior Sneak (Su)

The bedeviling blade can spend 1 point from their arcane reservoir as a swift action to become invisible for a number of rounds equal to their Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Attacking ends the effect immediately after the attack completes.

Trapfinding (Ex)

The bedeviling blade adds 1/2 their class level to Perception checks to locate traps and to Disable Device checks. They can also use Disable Device to disarm magic traps.

Greater Exploits

A bedeviling blade can select from the following additional greater exploits.

Guileful Spell (Ex)

Whenever the bedeviling blade casts a legendary arcanist spell, they may spend 1 point from their arcane reservoir as a move action to remove all somatic and verbal components from the spell.

Surprise Spells (Ex)

Requires: Sudden Spell

The bedeviling blade may spend 1 point from their arcane reservoir to use their sudden spell ability with spells that affect multiple targets. Only flat-footed targets are affected, but targets do not need to be within 30 feet.

Teleporting Sneak (Su)

Requires: Superior Sneak

Whenever the bedeviling blade uses their superior sneak ability, they may teleport 60 feet to a location they can see. The teleportation occurs after they become invisible, making their arrival unseen.

Ultimate Sneak (Su)

Requires: Superior Sneak

The bedeviling blade’s superior sneak ability lasts a number of minutes equal to their Charisma modifier (minimum 1) and attacking does not cause them to become visible.
